title: Implement
img: A construction worker in a hard hat stands on a timber wall frame against a blue sky.
extra: Teach `/implement` (one run, drives tdd and code-review, commits to the current branch) and `/implement-spec` (task graph, frontier, integration branch, subagents in worktrees, one review at the end), human-in-the-loop vs AFK, Matt's three ways to loop over tickets. Site story: real (PR #9 used `/implement-spec` with 5 tickets; 03 and 04 ran in parallel; one merge conflict in the shared credits file `unsplash.ts`; an early review ran while ticket 05 was still building; the author typed the next Skill before answering an open question). Check details with `gh pr view 9` and .scratch/main-flow-and-redesign/.
